scripts.db:reset: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of ['./procurement.db','./procurement.db-shm','./procurement.db-wal','./procurement.db.no-seed'])fs.rmSync(f,{force:true});console.log('database removed — it will be recreated and reseeded on next boot')"
scripts.db:clear: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of ['./procurement.db','./procurement.db-shm','./procurement.db-wal'])fs.rmSync(f,{force:true});fs.writeFileSync('./procurement.db.no-seed','');console.log('database removed — it will be recreated with reference data only (no demo purchase requests/activity) on next boot; run npm run db:reset for full seed data')"
